main_body: pair of wooden crates with metal corner brackets
top_band: light tan/brown horizontal planked top on rows 0-8 (large crate) and rows 8-14 (small crate)
evidence: Large crate shows a clear horizontal planked top surface across rows 0-8 (9 rows tall, ending with a light tan front edge on rows 7-8), followed by a dark eave/recess shadow on row 9 and an inset vertical front panel with a diagonal brace across rows 9-18 (10 rows tall). Small crate similarly has a 7-row top (rows 8-14) over an 8-row recessed front face (rows 15-22).

style.evidence: While the crates use dark brown material tones rather than pure black outlines, the surfaces are very geometric and repetitive: the top planks are simple alternating 1px horizontal stripes with zero wood grain or variation, and the front panel is a large flat dark-brown fill cut only by a uniform 1px staircase line. Compared to the Beodeul stall and well, it lacks organic pixel cluster shading and surface texture.
